MIN_POLICY_DELAY().notice: Immutable lower bounds. No policy update can reduce these.

PROPOSAL_EXECUTION_WINDOW().notice: Policy proposals can be executed for this long after their ETA.

ROLLING_WINDOW().notice: Rolling spend window and the gas-bounded reservation ring.

WITHDRAWAL_EXPIRY().notice: A queued withdrawal that is not executed in time expires.

cancelExpired(uint256).notice: Permissionless cleanup after expiry. Releases the reservation         so abandoned requests cannot lock the vault forever.

cancelRecovery().notice: Owner can cancel only a proposal it created; guardians can         cancel any proposal with two distinct cancel approvals.

cancelWithdrawal(uint256).notice: Cancelling releases both the reserved balance and the rolling         allowance immediately. Allowed while frozen.

freeze().notice: Monitor (or the owner as a panic button) can freeze. Repeated         calls are safe no-ops, so a retry after an ambiguous receipt         cannot revert the pipeline.

proposePolicy((uint256,uint256,uint256,u.notice: Every policy change is proposed and timelocked. Weakening         changes additionally require two guardian approvals. There is         no owner-only path to change limits, delays or allowlisting.

proposeRecovery(address).notice: Guardian-initiated recovery. The owner may also propose while         still in control. A proposal freezes exits immediately.         Owner cancellation is only possible for owner-initiated         proposals. A compromised owner therefore cannot veto recovery         initiated by the guardians; two guardians can cancel a bad         guardian proposal.

proposeRestoration().notice: Guardian-controlled release of a monitor freeze. This is the         false-positive path: it never replaces the owner and never         touches funds. The monitor cannot initiate, approve or execute         it. A compromised monitor can freeze again after restoration;         that is a denial-of-service trade-off, documented in the threat         model, not a path to theft.

requestWithdrawal(uint256,address).notice: Queue a withdrawal and reserve its balance and rolling-window         allowance immediately. No withdrawal is immediate.         Guardian approval is required when the request is at or above         the large threshold, or when cumulative spending in the rolling         window plus this request reaches that threshold. This prevents a         stolen key from splitting one large transfer into dust.

setAllowlisted(address,bool).notice: Adding a recipient is strengthening and immediate. Removing one         is weakening and must use proposeAllowlistRemoval.
